original.value: A bright anime-style fantasy travel scene in front of Niseko View Plaza in Hokkaido, with a clear blue sky, scattered white clouds, and a huge snow-capped mountain rising in the background. The setting is a roadside plaza parking area with a modern black-and-wood station building on the left, visible Japanese signage reading "道の駅 ニセコビュープラザ" and "Niseko View Plaza," a vertical banner reading "ようこそ ニセコへ," a tall food sign reading "名物 じゃがいも," and a dark wayfinding sign on the right reading "ニセコ Niseko" with 4 listed icons and labels: "名産品 Local Products," "農産物直売所 Farmer's Market," "レストラン Restaurant," and "情報コーナー Information." In the center, a glamorous fox-eared anime girl sits sideways atop a giant iridescent translucent soap bubble, smiling and gesturing upward with one hand. She has {argument name="hair color" default="shimmering pastel silver-lilac"} very long wavy hair, large fluffy fox ears, and a huge fluffy fox tail with rainbow-reflective highlights. Her outfit is an elaborate sparkling translucent-white and pale blue dress with holographic sheen, layered sleeves, gemstone accents, ribbons, and glossy lace-up ankle boots with bows, giving her a magical bubble-fox idol appearance. Around her float multiple smaller soap bubbles, catching rainbow light. Three fox-girl friends gather around meeting her at the plaza: 1 dark-haired fox-eared girl in a navy jacket with a Niseko patch, holding a vanilla soft-serve ice cream and looking toward the center; 1 khaki-clad fox-eared girl in an outdoor jacket and a dark cap with "HOTEL" lettering, holding a grilled corn cob; and 1 white-haired fox-eared girl in a shiny pearly hooded jacket and beret, holding a takeaway coffee cup and wearing a black backpack. Emphasize a cheerful reunion mood, travel photography composition blended with polished anime illustration, detailed environmental signage, reflective bubble surfaces, soft sunlight, crisp mountain air, and high-detail painterly rendering.

zh-CN.value:
北海道二世谷展望广场前的明亮动漫风格奇幻旅行场景，有清澈的蓝天、散落的白云，以及远处耸立的巨大雪山。场景是一个路边广场停车场，左侧有一座现代黑木车站建筑，可见日文招牌写着"道の駅 ニセコビュープラザ"和"Niseko View Plaza"，一条垂直横幅写着"ようこそ ニセコへ"，一个高大的食物招牌写着"名物 じゃがいも"，右侧还有一个深色的指路牌写着"ニセコ Niseko"，列有4个图标和标签："名産品 Local Products"、"農産物直売所 Farmer's Market"、"レストラン Restaurant"和"情報コーナー Information"。

中心位置，一个华丽的狐狸耳动漫女孩侧坐在巨大的彩虹半透明肥皂泡上，微笑着一只手向上指着。她有{argument name="hair color" default="shimmering pastel silver-lilac"}非常长的波浪长发，蓬松的狐狸耳朵，以及带有彩虹反光高光的大蓬松狐狸尾巴。她的服装是一件精致的闪亮半透明白色和淡蓝色连衣裙，具有全息光泽，分层袖子，宝石装饰，丝带，以及带有蝴蝶结的光亮系带踝靴，赋予她一种神奇的泡泡狐狸偶像形象。周围漂浮着多个较小的肥皂泡，捕捉彩虹光芒。

三个狐狸耳朋友在广场上与她相聚：1个深色头发的狐狸耳女孩，穿着带有二世谷徽章的海军蓝夹克，拿着香草软冰淇淋，望向中心；1个卡其色打扮的狐狸耳女孩，穿着户外夹克和带有"HOTEL"字样的深色帽子，拿着烤玉米棒；1个白发的狐狸耳女孩，穿着闪亮的珍珠色连帽夹克和贝雷帽，拿着外卖咖啡杯，背着黑色背包。

强调欢乐重逢的氛围，旅行摄影构图与精致的动漫插画相结合，详细的环境标识，反光的泡泡表面，柔和的阳光，清新的山间空气，以及高细节的绘画渲染风格。
